channel.title: Pier & Point · Coming up
channel.description: Coming up changes and milestones, for four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront. Every item names its source.

item.title: Expected · Potrero Power Station Block 12: Developer proposes a Development Agreement amendment increasing Block 12's permitted height by 23 feet, and giving Block 12 flexibility to become residential instead of commercial (2026)
item.description: Developer proposes a Development Agreement amendment increasing Block 12's permitted height by 23 feet, and giving Block 12 flexibility to become residential instead of commercial (2026). Source: San Francisco Chronicle (Laura Waxmann), 2026-07-29.

item.title: Expected · Potrero Power Station Block 15 / Station A: Developer (Fifth Space) requests a Development Agreement amendment to increase Station A's permitted height by 30 feet, among other changes, to make its 'smaller floorplate' more attractive to commercial tenants (2026)
item.description: Developer (Fifth Space) requests a Development Agreement amendment to increase Station A's permitted height by 30 feet, among other changes, to make its 'smaller floorplate' more attractive to commercial tenants (2026). Source: San Francisco Chronicle (Laura Waxmann), 2026-07-29.

item.title: Expected · Pier 54: Port's draft Five-Year Capital Improvement Program (FY2027-31) budgets a "Pier 54 Shed Demolition" line item totaling $2.0M: $500,000 in FY2026-27 and $1,500,000 in FY2027-28. No line item for full substructure removal appears in the same document. (Feb 2026)
item.description: Port's draft Five-Year Capital Improvement Program (FY2027-31) budgets a "Pier 54 Shed Demolition" line item totaling $2.0M: $500,000 in FY2026-27 and $1,500,000 in FY2027-28. No line item for full substructure removal appears in the same document. (Feb 2026). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-02.

item.title: Expected · Third Street Garage: Construction slated to begin in March 2004, per the 2003 Regents budget item (a plan, not a reported start) (2004)
item.description: Construction slated to begin in March 2004, per the 2003 Regents budget item (a plan, not a reported start) (2004). Source: Regents of the University of California, 2003-11-06.
